name: NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10)
notes: Grace Blackwell superchip, 128 GB unified between the 20-core Grace CPU and the Blackwell GPU; about 121 GiB is visible to the OS. The FP4 figure is NVIDIA's 1 PFLOP sparse marketing number; dense FP4/FP8/FP16 are halved from it and are estimates, not measurements. sm_121 runs sm_120 cubins. Memory bandwidth is the number that matters here: 273 GB/s makes it a capacity machine, not a throughput machine.
